{{Youmay|War Chief|[[warchief]]}}
[[File:WarChiefRobetheri.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Robetheri]], the War Chief.]]
The title of '''War Chief''' was a high-level military function among the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the equivalent of a [[General/Legends|general]]. [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sister]] [[Robetheri]] was the War Chief of her coven.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
